name: Offboard leavers from the HRIS to Okta, Jira and Google Workspace with Claude

parameters.content:
## Offboard leavers from the HRIS to Okta, Jira and Google Workspace with Claude

IT and HR teams that revoke access and collect equipment from a checklist that is never quite complete.

### How it works
Trigger: The HRIS fires when an employment end date is set.
1. Receive the termination record
2. Assemble the leaver's access map
3. Open revocation tickets with deadlines
4. Schedule equipment return
5. Generate the knowledge-transfer checklist
6. Hand off to finance and payroll
7. Send the exit survey
8. Confirm closure
Every AI step is followed by a "Needs a person?" gate that parks low-confidence items.

### Setup
1. Open "Config (edit me)" and fill in the fields (names, approver, quiet hours, thresholds).
2. Add credentials: Anthropic, plus Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace, Jira Service Management / ServiceNow, Typeform / Google Forms.
3. Run once with test_mode on, read the output, then switch the trigger on.

### Customization tips
Edit the access-revocation order and the exit-survey questions in the Config node; add your own SaaS admin APIs as extra revocation nodes.
Guardrail to keep: The workflow requests revocation; IT executes it.

Full blueprint: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/employee-offboarding-automation/

## 1. Receive the termination record
Employee, role, last working day, reason category (voluntary/involuntary), manager and location

## 2. Assemble the leaver's access map
Queries the identity provider and the tracking board from onboarding for every system this person was granted, so nothing is guessed

nodes.name: Section: 2. Assemble the leaver's access map

parameters.content:
## 3. Open revocation tickets with deadlines
One ticket per system, due at the agreed time on the last day (or immediately for involuntary exits), assigned to IT with the account identifiers pre-filled

nodes.name: Section: 3. Open revocation tickets with deadlines

parameters.content:
## 4. Schedule equipment return
Sends the return instructions or courier label, records the asset tags, and adds a follow-up task if the equipment is not back within 7 days

## 5. Generate the knowledge-transfer checklist
Drafts a handover document for the manager from the role description and recent project data (Jira, Notion, Drive): open items, recurring responsibilities, systems owned, people to introduce

## 6. Hand off to finance and payroll
Creates the final-pay task with last day, accrued leave and pending expenses, and notifies payroll with a deadline that respects local rules

nodes.name: Section: 6. Hand off to finance and payroll

parameters.content:
## 7. Send the exit survey
Typeform or Google Form sent on the last day, results stored on the board and summarised quarterly by department

## 8. Confirm closure
Daily run checks every revocation ticket is closed and every asset is back; escalates open items to the IT lead and HR after the deadline

## Fill this in first
Every later node reads these values. Keep test_mode on for the first week.

- Identity provider group membership (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace)
- Onboarding tracking board (what was granted)
- IT ticketing system
- Asset register (sheet or ITAM tool)

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Generate the knowledge-transfer checklist" step of the Employee Offboarding Automation Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: Drafts a handover document for the manager from the role description and recent project data (Jira, Notion, Drive): open items, recurring responsibilities, systems owned, people to introduce. The manager edits, not writes.

Rules:
- The workflow requests revocation; IT executes it. Nothing is deleted automatically.
- Involuntary exits skip the welcome-style messaging and trigger same-day revocation tickets.
- The knowledge-transfer draft never includes compensation or performance data.
- Closure is verified, not assumed: open tickets escalate until an IT lead closes them.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.
